video_title: Jalen Brunson put the Knicks on his back & Wemby was NONEXISTENT! 🔊 - Perk on Game 4 | SportsCenter

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins praises Jalen Brunson and OG Anunoby's performance
quotes.excerpt: It was a beautiful performance by OG Anunoby and Big Body Brunson.

text_blocks.speaker: Nicole Briscoe
text_blocks.text: Think about what the Knicks did, first half to second half. How did they do it?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I am going to give you a word for this performance. It was beautiful. It was a beautiful performance by OG Anunoby and Big Body Brunson.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins defends Jalen Brunson against critics
quotes.excerpt: I got to tip my hat to Big Body Brunson because it was a lot of people.
quotes.quote: I got to tip my hat to Big Body Brunson because it was a lot of people out there criticizing him after Game 3, saying that he was dribbling the oxygen out of the ball, saying that he needed to pass the ball. But what he did was, he put this team on his back in the second half, didn't make no excuses, and he went out in great fashion and got the dub.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins critiques Spurs' shot selection and Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: They just kept shooting threes. Are y'all not going to put pressure on the basket?
quotes.quote: The first thing was that they just kept shooting threes. And I kept saying to myself, are y'all not going to put pressure on the basket? Are y'all not going to attack the rim? And especially Victor Wembanyama, he started settling in late. We saw De'Aaron Fox, he kept settling. Stefan Castle, and I'm saying the Knicks had no answer for them for as when they had put their head down and got to the paint.

quotes.speaker: Michael Wilbon
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Wilbon criticizes Spurs' reliance on three-point shooting
quotes.excerpt: The Spurs had hit like 73% of their threes. And I remember turning to somebody, Stephen A.
quotes.quote: I am going to start at a point looking up at the scoreboard when the Spurs had hit like 73% of their threes. And I remember turning to somebody, might have been Stephen A. Smith, saying this is not sustainable. But the question is, how long do they sustain it and will there be enough time to come back?

quotes.speaker: Michael Wilbon
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Wilbon recalls John Thompson's coaching advice
quotes.excerpt: Just keep playing, son. Just keep playing.
quotes.quote: Reminds me of a phrase I used to hear from the great late John Thompson. When his team was down, he would tell, whether it was from Patrick Ewing to Dikembe to Alonzo to Allen Iverson, just keep playing, son. Just keep playing. And I thought of it because that's what Anunoby and Brunson did. They just kept playing.

quotes.speaker: Michael Wilbon
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Wilbon calls Spurs' loss the biggest choke job
quotes.excerpt: This tonight is the biggest choke job I've seen at a championship level.
quotes.quote: I am trying to be careful here because I am talking about the Spurs who I have so much respect for the people who lorded over this organization, who defined the organization, Gregg Popovich and Tim Duncan and David Robinson. This tonight is the biggest choke job I've seen at a championship level in any sport at any time.
